name: Crossfade ni Ochita Yume
original_name: クロスフェードに堕ちた夢
source:
One year ago main character suddenly lost his memory. One day he meets a girl in need for help. He takes his gun and protects the girl chased by a mysterious organization. With that the memories of the past gradually start to recover revealing unpleasant truth...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-february-2004-forest.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一年前，主人公突然失去了记忆。一天，他遇见一名需要帮助的女孩，于是拿起枪，保护被神秘组织追赶的她。随着这次行动，过去的记忆逐渐恢复，也揭示出令人不快的真相……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-february-2004-forest.html]vndbreview[/url]]
